name: BDIXPulse
description: Source-attributed BDIX service directory with bounded public endpoint checks.

paragraphs: Discover listed Bangladesh internet-exchange services and check which configured public endpoints respond right now.

BDIX Pulse is a public directory and availability tool for people exploring Bangladesh-focused FTP libraries, video services, television streams, game servers, software mirrors, and radio services. It combines a source-attributed catalogue with a bounded server-side probe so visitors can find a destination, check its current application-level signal, and open it without treating that signal as proof of their own ISP route or bandwidth.

The current catalogue contains 266 unique researched services, including 234 public diagnostic endpoints. The remaining customer-network-only records stay discoverable without being sent to the cloud probe.
features: The Directory records what has been researched and where the listing came from.
The Test experience reports a fresh response from the BDIX Pulse application probe.
The Guide explains what Open, Failed, and Not checked mean—and what they do not prove.
Search 266 source-attributed services by name, category, operator, hostname, or evidence source.
Filter the directory by FTP, video, television, game, software, or radio category.

whatItDoes.text: Discover listed Bangladesh internet-exchange services and check which configured public endpoints respond right now.

requirements.text: BDIX Pulse does not currently provide user accounts or persist diagnostic history in a database.
